source: National Crime Victimization Survey (NCVS), Race and Hispanic Origin of Victims and Offenders, 2012–15 (BJS)
notes: Data are for victims ages 12–17 (not ages 0–11).
Offender race is based on the victim’s perception, not verified identification by law enforcement.
Covers nonfatal violent crime: rape/sexual assault, robbery, aggravated assault, and simple assault.
Not limited to the three serious offenses in the FBI Child Victimization report.
The published FBI NIBRS Child Victimization summary does not contain a victim-race × offender-race cross-tab for under-18 victims.
Percentages are approximate from the published tables and may not sum to 100% due to other/unknown categories.
